about_the_game:
🌫️ CloudSeeker

A Mythic Metroidvania of Discovery, Not Punishment

Step into the mist-shrouded world of CloudSeeker, a beginner-friendly 2D Metroidvania inspired by the rich tapestry of Chinese mythology. Journey as Yun, a determined explorer traversing forgotten realms and confronting mythical beasts as you unravel the mysteries of the ancient world.

🧭 Explore at Your Pace

CloudSeeker is crafted for players who love discovery without the grind. Navigate interconnected environments filled with secrets, lore, and ancient deities, all designed with intuitive progression, smart level design, and forgiving mechanics.

⚔️ Combat & Abilities

Wield elegant weapons and unlock powerful abilities that allow you to reach new areas and tackle evolving challenges. Combat is fluid, satisfying, and accessible—perfect for both newcomers and genre veterans.

🌏 Inspired by Chinese Mythology

A beginner-friendly Metroidvania rooted in Chinese mythology. Explore a mystical world filled with characters inspired by the Chinese Zodiac, unlock powerful abilities, and uncover ancient secrets—all with intuitive progression and forgiving platforming.

🗺️ Quality of Life Matters

  • Fast Travel & Checkpoints

  • Visual hints and readable maps

  • Accessible platforming, no pixel-perfect jumps

  • Casual-friendly without sacrificing depth

💡 Features:

  • A vast, interconnected world filled with secrets and lore

  • Combat that rewards precision but forgives mistakes

  • Abilities that enhance exploration and storytelling

  • Mythical beasts and divine entities drawn from Chinese folklore

  • A stylized, hand-crafted aesthetic

short_description: Drift adventurously in the world of Cloud Seeker! A Chinese inspired action-platformer where Yun, a young rabbit once chosen to inherit a great legacy, has to prove his worth after a sealed god is unleashed upon the world with the help of his trusted companions.
